name: Dallas Parts Distribution Center - Grand Prairie TX

fieldNotes.location: Address 3010 Roy Orr Blvd, Suite 140, Grand Prairie TX 75050 — DTNA Dallas PDC, a 275,000 sq ft facility, confirmed via Daimler careers location page and business listings. Roster rooftop geocode moved only 111 m and landed on the correct building. Center locked at 32.797300, -97.031700.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE. Street View (2024-12) shows a chain-link perimeter fence enclosing the south truck court / dock yard, with a controlled slide gate at the driveway entrance — a truck was captured driving in through the gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE. No guard booth structure at the gate or anywhere on the truck side.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: TRUE. There is a controlled truck gate but no guard shack — implies kiosk / badge / app check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: All dock doors on the south long face (single dock bank). Continuous door rhythm the full building length; estimate ~40 doors, 25-50 band — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: South truck court has rows of angled trailer drop stalls plus trailers backed into docks; well over 50 trailers' worth of parking. 50+ band, dropYard true.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Roughly 55 trailers counted across the south truck court (backed-in plus parking rows) — estimate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: FALSE. Docks are a single bank on the south face only; the north wall has no dock face (it abuts a neighboring equipment-rental yard).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide, deep south truck court easily stages 3+ trucks before the docks.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single gated driveway into the fenced truck court used for both entry and exit.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Single gated entrance into the fenced yard; no obvious unused paved width for an express bypass at the gate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense industrial district of Grand Prairie within the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex; Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.

citations.claim: Daimler Truck careers page for the Dallas PDC at 3010 Roy Orr Blvd Suite 140, Grand Prairie TX 75050; supports Freightliner/Western Star/Thomas Built dealers.

verification.rationale: Two current official daimlertruck.com pages name DTNA's own Dallas PDC at the exact address; gauntlet clean (2026-27 relocations hit Phoenix/Reno, not Dallas).
